message:
cmd/compile/internal/reflectdata: don't overwrite pos in hashFunc/eqFunc

We're already threading pos here. We don't need to overwrite base.Pos. It was verified that this does not change the compiler output for std
or cmd.

For #19683


[git-generate]
cd src/cmd/compile/internal/reflectdata
rf '
	rm hashFunc:/base\.Pos = pos\n/ eqFunc:/base\.Pos = pos\n/
'
